page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Left margin: a section number "XIII." beside the first paragraph. Bottom right: the catchword "tus".

main_text.p: Magus, radicésque nominavit, quæ quidem conjugationes cum Simone ipso & sua impurissima Helena, octonarium effi-cerunt numerum; Triginta vero Æones Valentinianis ( totidem quippe excogi-tabant ) non autem Marcion stis quibus XIII. id imprudenter affinxit Nazianzenus.

Vindicata celeberrimi Blondelli opi-nione, videamus quid adversus Dallæi sententiam objiciat doctissimus Vindicia-rum Auctor; Dallæus siquidem asserebat Logon ex Sige, tanquam à matre filium, vel tanquam ab avia nepotem, procreatum esse, neminem ante Valentinum do-cuisse, hancque Logi ex Sige emanationem proprium esse ac peculiarem hæresis Valentini characterem: Pearsonius vero contra affirmat Basilidem inter Gnosticos Valentino vetustiores fuisse, & de Logo pariter ac Valentinum sensisse, quod probat pag. 65. quibusdam Theodoreti verbis Fab. Hæret. lib.5. cap. xi, cum inquit, Valentini de Verbo sententiam recitasset, hæc addit, Basilides quoque si[?]liter alium Unigenitum, aliud Verbum, & aliam dixit esse Sapientiam; hinc colligit Basilidem Monogenem & Verbum similiter distinxisse, quia Verbum ex Monogene similiter eduxit; hæc consequentia est Viri do-cti, non autem Theodoreti; Theodore-

page.notes: The word "similiter" in the italic phrase "Basilides quoque similiter" is obscured by a dark ink blot; it is read as "si[?]liter". The stain at the top right corner and the Google digitiser watermark at the bottom right are not transcribed. The word "stis" after "non autem Marcion" is faint at its start and may be "istis"; it is copied as "stis". The catchword "tus" is set at the right below the last line.
